cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Taste this cheap coffee substitute before I fill my cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. If you like this, we can save the proper stuff for guests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not sacrificing breakfast to save you money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sip. If it's awful, I'll buy you a croissant and keep my cup empty.

mechanism: A frames testing a cheap substitute as the pupil application of its budgeting lessons before A commits its own breakfast.
confusable: Not general thrift advice: A keeps its cup empty until B supplies the result.
comparison: Hands-on repair under spray risk versus small tasting under compensation terms.
seedUse: Keep D32 substitute/real coffee/breakfast/croissant; S05 treating refusal as a learned value distinction supports persuasion.
